# SmartHomePairingWizard

**Class:** `SmartHomePairingWizard` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Adding a device

## Overview

@brief Pairing wizard Choose the radio (a button per protocol), then it searches - a progress bar, what to do, Cancel - until a new device joins the home ("Added ...", Done) or the time runs out (what went wrong, Back). It watches for the new device itself, on a timer, so it leaves SmartHomeAPI's callbacks to the host.
